list.name: Changes
list.comment:
Refine Scout triage/telemetry and declutter Companion AI & composer UI
Scout AI Optimization & Telemetry: - Switch Scout calls (triage, summarization, headers, git drafts, and stateless inspection) to lowest-overhead MINIMAL thinking with automatic LOW/OFF fallback when unsupported. - Make Scout failure triage selective: skip Scout when failures are short (<=1500 chars) and un-focused; when Scout triage runs in Bridge mode, omit redundant raw output previews when an executive summary is produced. - Track Scout API usage separately (`source='scout'` in `api_usage_events` with migration) and compute per-model and aggregate RPM/TPM/RPD/token metrics via `get_telemetry_snapshot`. - Expose live Scout and Main AI telemetry across settings, sessions, chat, bridge, and git endpoints so metrics update in both API and Bridge modes.
UI Declutter & Composer Refinements: - Unify sidebar `Main AI` and `Scout AI` cards with header ON/OFF switches, concise 1-line stat strips, and a shared floating `Details` popover for token breakdowns, reset windows, and per-model history. - Prompt to create a new API or Playground Bridge session when toggling the `Main AI` switch rather than mutating existing session mode. - Move `Scout AI` toggle and `Auto-run prompts` switch into the Scout sidebar card (collapsing the panel when OFF) and `Run Tests` into the Console drawer toolbar. - Declutter the topbar and auto-size the session title input so the `[API]`/`[BRIDGE]` badge sits directly next to the title. - Consolidate Chrome `:9222` controls into the composer (`Chrome ↻` when offline; reveals tab picker and capture buttons only when connected). - Standardize composer button heights and replace the standalone Directives pill with a `[ Copy ... | ▾ ]` split button supporting `Skip Directives`, `Include Directives`, `Copy Directives Only`, and `Copy Prompt + Directives`, disabling the main copy button when empty.
Tests: - Add unit tests for selective failure triage, lowest thinking levels, and per-model Scout telemetry in Bridge mode; update UI contract assertions for the new panel and split-button DOM layout.

task.summary: Initial commit of the Gemini Vibe Code Companion.
Initial commit of the Gemini Vibe Code Companion.
Initial commit of the Gemini Vibe Code Companion.
Major upgrade to workflows and theming.

Add Playground Bridge workflow, human-gated file/script tools, live Console streaming, atomic checkpoints, UI themes, and auto-cleaning SQLite storage
Workspace & Tool Execution - Add human-gated `delete_file` and `rename_file` tools with diff previews and pre-change backups in `backup/`. - Add `run_script` for gated execution of existing/patched `.py` scripts with optional CLI args, plus `run_and_delete_script` (and `Write, Run & Delete on Pass` / `delete_on_success` on `propose_script`) to automatically delete passing inspection scripts while keeping failing ones on disk for patching. - Capture and return up to 12,000 chars of stdout/stderr for `propose_script` even on exit code 0, and extract concise traceback excerpts on failure. - Upgrade `run_tests` with optional `fast: true` and `target` quick/single-file syntax check modes while preserving full-suite verification as default. - Support generic language `search_code` filters (`is_regex`, `path_glob`, `subpath`, `start_line`/`end_line`) and nearest-line diagnostics on `patch_literal` mismatches.
Console, Savepoints & Live Streaming - Unify UI naming around "Console" and stream stdout/stderr chunks live over WebSocket (`exec_start`, `exec_chunk`, `exec_done`) into both the Console drawer and running chat cards. - Add transactional filesystem checkpoints (`<backup_dir>/.checkpoints/`) created automatically before write batches, with 1-click Restore, auto-commit on passing full `run_tests`, and Console **Commit Savepoint** / **Restore** controls after manual Console runs.
Playground Bridge, Prompts & Safety - Externalize editable prompts under `static/prompts/` (`system_prompt.txt`, `bridge_tool_contract.txt`, `git_commit_prompt.txt`) loaded dynamically without restarting. - Enforce a hard-stop parser rule and truncation after the closing ` ``` ` of the first JSON command block in Bridge replies to prevent runaway continuation/hallucinated results. - Declutter Bridge composer actions to **Copy Starter/Prompt → Playground** and **Paste & Run AI Reply** (with automatic fallback paste box if clipboard read is blocked) and add inline detection/recovery when AI tool JSON is pasted into `#prompt-input`.
UI Themes, Git Workflow & Automatic DB/Backup Hygiene - Refactor styling to semantic CSS tokens with a persistent bottom-left theme selector (Midnight Blue, Darcula, Nordic Slate, Clean Light, Warm Paper, Espresso, Forest Night). - Add UI-driven Git drawer workflow (live `git status` & diff, Gemini-drafted commit messages, Commit, and Commit & Push) plus Chrome CDP (`:9222`) tab/screenshot/console capture and dynamic free/paid model catalog probing with PST/PDT rate telemetry. - Add automatic `backup/` and `.checkpoints/` size/age/count pruning plus automatic SQLite maintenance (`storage/db.py` startup & incremental pruning of resolved gates, old `patch_history`/checkpoints, >60-message session trimming, older payload/image compaction, and WAL checkpoint + `VACUUM`).

Scout AI Optimization & Telemetry: - Switch Scout calls (triage, summarization, headers, git drafts, and stateless inspection) to lowest-overhead MINIMAL thinking with automatic LOW/OFF fallback when unsupported. - Make Scout failure triage selective: skip Scout when failures are short (<=1500 chars) and un-focused; when Scout triage runs in Bridge mode, omit redundant raw output previews when an executive summary is produced. - Track Scout API usage separately (`source='scout'` in `api_usage_events` with migration) and compute per-model and aggregate RPM/TPM/RPD/token metrics via `get_telemetry_snapshot`. - Expose live Scout and Main AI telemetry across settings, sessions, chat, bridge, and git endpoints so metrics update in both API and Bridge modes.
